_doc: Live predict evaluation (tests/test_predict_eval.py). Checks: type (answer | escalate), escalate (code, when type is escalate), depends_on (null | set | any), language (ru | en | de | uk), stance (accept | decline | non_committal | any). Principle: depends_on comes only from the owner's claims; no applicable claim -> out_of_persona. Ids ending in _p1/_p2 are paraphrases of the scenario with the same id prefix: same persona, facts and expectations, different wording, to measure robustness over wording. Optional style checks (only on type: answer): style.<persona> applies to every answer of that persona: max_chars, lowercase_start, capital_start, no_final_period, absent_any (case-insensitive substrings). Optional per-scenario now (ISO time) overrides the global now.
